summary: The Chains of Eternity Dungeon is the binding sanctum of Zebuxoruk’s Prison. Void‑forged chains, temporal anchors, and eternity locks hold the prisoner outside time. Collapse threatens to break the bindings, unleashing cosmic instability.
history: Forged during the first planar war to bind Zebuxoruk beyond time.
Temporal anchors stabilized the prison’s bindings.
Void chains formed naturally from collapse pressure.
The Eternal Binder arose as guardian of the chains.
Collapse now threatens to shatter the bindings.
